name: TV/Commercial Display Production Line Solutions
summary: Full line automation solutions for TV, commercial display, education conference all-in-one, and digital signage manufacturers, covering the entire process of dispensing, laminating, flipping, inspection, bagging, and palletizing.
contentHtml:
The TV/Commercial Display Flexible Assembly Line is a full line automation solution provided by TXAM for TV, commercial display, education conference all-in-one, and digital signage manufacturers.

Solution Composition

The full line covers the entire process from dispensing, bracket placement, laminating, flipping inspection, to final bagging and palletizing, achieving fully automated production from raw materials to finished products.

Technical Advantages

  • One-click compatibility with 65-110 inch multi-size products, solving large-size production challenges
  • Full process robotic automation, significantly improving production efficiency
  • CAD import for one-click model change, short debugging time, minimal capacity loss
  • High overall line yield, consistent product quality
  • Self-developed WMS/WCS system, breaking information silos
  • True turnkey project, one-stop service

Service Content

TXAM provides full process support from solution design, equipment manufacturing, installation and debugging to after-sales service, truly realizing a turnkey project.

painPoints.title: Difficulty in Large-Size Assembly
painPoints.desc: Manual assembly of display devices over 65 inches is difficult, with low efficiency and high breakage rates

painPoints.title: Complex Multi-Model Changeover
painPoints.desc: Long changeover times and high debugging costs for multi-model production, making flexible production difficult

painPoints.title: High Risk in Manual Flipping
painPoints.desc: Flipping large-size products relies on manual labor, posing safety risks and easily causing product damage

painPoints.title: Insufficient Dispensing Accuracy
painPoints.desc: Traditional dispensing equipment has low precision, many bubbles, and cannot guarantee sealing performance

painPoints.title: Low Packaging Efficiency
painPoints.desc: Post-process packaging is cumbersome, with high manual bagging and palletizing costs and slow cycle times

painPoints.title: Severe Information Silos
painPoints.desc: Lack of information exchange between devices, making digital management and quality traceability difficult

process.title: Automatic Dispensing
process.desc: High-precision robotic dispensing with ±0.2mm positioning accuracy, multi-nozzle matrix collaboration

process.title: Precision Laminating
process.desc: Constant pressure control laminating with ±0.15mm accuracy, no bubbles, no misalignment

process.title: Safe Flipping
process.desc: 180-degree heavy-load flipping with one-button operation, solving large-size product flipping challenges

process.title: Visual Inspection
process.desc: AI vision system for automatic inspection, online quality control, ensuring product consistency

process.title: Automatic Bagging
process.desc: Robotic automatic bagging packaging, saving labor, improving packaging efficiency

process.title: Intelligent Palletizing
process.desc: Six-axis robotic intelligent palletizing with ±0.5mm accuracy, 12 seconds per piece for efficient palletizing

process.title: One-Click Model Change
process.desc: CAD drawing import for quick product model change, significantly reducing debugging time

process.title: Data Traceability
process.desc: WMS/WCS system enables transparent production data, full quality traceability
